set.seed(4675)
library(Rcpp)
rremb <- function(n, params) {
  alpha<- params$alpha
  alpha_x0 <-  alpha+ params$x0
  alpha_x0_new<- -alpha + params$x0
  eta_minus1 <- params$eta - 1
  alpha_pow <- alpha^(-eta_minus1)
  
  cste_new <- 2*alpha_pow - (alpha_x0^(-eta_minus1))
  
  y <- runif(n)
  y<-(1-y)*cste_new
  resultats <- numeric(n)
  inv_eta_minus1 <- 1 / eta_minus1
  condition_1 <- y >=alpha_pow
  
  resultats[condition_1] <- alpha_x0 - (2*alpha_pow - y[condition_1])^(-inv_eta_minus1)
  resultats[!condition_1] <- alpha_x0_new + y[!condition_1]^(-inv_eta_minus1)
  return(resultats)
}

simulate_weather_vectorized <- function(days, params) {
  pSN <- params$ptrans[1]
  pNS <- params$ptrans[2]
  pNP <- params$ptrans[3]
  pPN <- params$ptrans[4]
  ptrans <- matrix(c(
    1 - pSN, pSN, 0,
    pNS, 1 - (pNS + pNP), pNP,
    0, pPN, 1 - pPN
  ), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  weather <- integer(days)
  weather[1] <- 1
  for (day in 2:days) {
    current_state <- weather[day - 1]
    weather[day] <- sample(1:3, 1, prob = ptrans[current_state, ])
  }
  return(weather)
}

msa <- function(n.simul, params) {
  #nombre de motards
  N <- params$N
  #seuil
  s <- params$s
  #nombre de jours
  days <- 365
  #probabilites de transition
  ptrans <- params$ptrans
  #probabilites d'accidents
  pacc <- params$pacc
  
  R_values <- numeric(n.simul)
  
  prob_accident<-numeric(days)
  
  for (sim in 1:n.simul) {
    #creation d'un vecteur de taille days avec les meteos pour chaque jour  
    weather <- simulate_weather_vectorized(days, params)
    
    #on affcete en fonction de la meteo les probabilites d'accident
    prob_accident[weather==1]<- pacc[1]
    prob_accident[weather==2]<- pacc[2]
    prob_accident[weather==3]<- pacc[3]
    
    #on recupere le nombre d'accident qui on eu lieu pour les days jours
    num_accidents_per_day  <-rbinom(days, N, prob_accident)
    
    #on somme pour obtenir le nombre d'accident pour l'annee
    tot<-sum(num_accidents_per_day)
    
    #on applique la fonction rremb pour avoir le remboursement pour chacun des accidents
    reimbursements <- rremb(tot,params)
    
    R_values[sim] <- sum(reimbursements)
    
  }
  
  # Calcul de l'espérance conditionnelle m(s) = E(R - s | R > s)
  ms1 <- R_values[R_values > s]
  #moyenne
  m_s<- mean(ms1)-s
  #ecart type
  sigma<-sd(ms1)
  
  n<-length(ms1)
  
  return(list(ms = m_s, demi.largeur=(1.96*sigma/sqrt(n))))
}

msb <- function(n.simul, params) {
  N <- params$N
  s <- params$s
  days <- 365
  ptrans <- params$ptrans
  pacc <- params$pacc
  
  R_values <- numeric(n.simul)
  
  weather <-simulate_weather_vectorized(days, params)
  nbS<-sum(weather==1)
  nbN<-sum(weather==2)
  nbP<-sum(weather==3)
  # Indices des 1
  indices_1 <- which(weather == 1)
  diff_indices_1 <- diff(indices_1)
  # Indices des 2
  indices_2 <- which(weather == 2)
  diff_indices_2 <- diff(indices_2)
  # Indices des 3
  indices_3 <- which(weather == 3)
  diff_indices_3 <- diff(indices_3)
  #creation des variances estimées pour chaque état (S,N,P)
  Vn_S<-sd(diff_indices_1)
  Vn_N<-sd(diff_indices_2)
  Vn_P<-sd(diff_indices_3)
  
  for (sim in 1:n.simul) {
    epsilon_S<-runif(1,-Vn_S,Vn_S)
    epsilon_N<-runif(1,-Vn_N,Vn_N)
    epsilon_P<- -(epsilon_S+epsilon_N) #il faut conserver une relation lineaire entre les epsilons pour etre sur qu'à la fin on ait toujours 365 éléments pour weather
    
    labels <- c(1,2,3)
    repetitions <- c(nbS+epsilon_S,nbN+epsilon_N,nbP+epsilon_P)
    
    # Création des niveaux avec répétitions spécifiques
    weather <- factor(sample(rep(labels, times = repetitions)))
    
    # Affichage
    # Calculer les probabilités d'accidents pour chaque motard et chaque jour
    prob_accident <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = days)
    prob_accident[weather == 1] <- pacc[1]
    prob_accident[weather == 2] <- pacc[2]
    prob_accident[weather == 3] <- pacc[3]
    
    # Simuler les accidents pour tous les motards en une seule opération
    accidents <- rbinom(N * days, 1, prob_accident)
    
    num_accidents <- sum(accidents)
    
    R_values[sim] <- sum(rremb(num_accidents, params)) - s
  }
  
  # Calcul de l'espérance conditionnelle m(s) = E(R - s | R > s)
  ms1 <- R_values[R_values > 0]
  m_s<- mean(ms1)
  
  sigma<-sd(ms1)
  n<-length(ms1)
  
  return(list(ms = m_s, demi.largeur=(1.96*sigma/sqrt(n))))
}
params <- list(
  alpha=1,
  x0=1,
  eta=3.5,
  s=4000,
  N=10000,
  ptrans=c(0.3,0.2,0.1, 0.4),
  pacc = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.1)  # Probabilité d'accident en Soleil, Nuages, Pluie
)
system.time(a<-msb(1000,params))
a


msb.c<-function(n.simul,params){
  N <- params$N
  s <- params$s
  days <- 365
  ptrans <- params$ptrans
  pacc <- params$pacc
  cppFunction('List msbc1(int days,List params,NumericVector ptrans,Function simulate_weather_vectorized){
                RNGScope scope;
                NumericVector weather=simulate_weather_vectorized(days,params);
                int nbS = std::count(weather.begin(), weather.end(), 1);
                int nbN = std::count(weather.begin(), weather.end(), 2);
                int nbP = std::count(weather.begin(), weather.end(), 3);
                //code pour remplacer le which de R :
                
                std::vector<int> indices_1=which_indices(weather,1);
                std::vector<int> indices_2=which_indices(weather,2);
                std::vector<int> indices_3=which_indices(weather,3);
                //code pour remplacer le diff de R :
                
                std::vector<int> diff_indices_1=diff_indices(indices_1);
                std::vector<int> diff_indices_2=diff_indices(indices_2);
                std::vector<int> diff_indices_3=diff_indices(indices_3);
                
                
                
            return List::create(
      _["diff_indices_1"] = diff_indices_1,
      _["diff_indices_2"] = diff_indices_2,
      _["diff_indices_3"] = diff_indices_3,
      _["nbr de S"]=nbS,
      _["nbr de N"]=nbN,
      _["nbr de P"]=nbP
    );
  }       
',includes=c('std::vector<int> which_indices(const NumericVector& weather, int etat) {
                std::vector<int> indices;
                for (int i = 0; i < weather.size(); ++i) {
                        if (weather[i] == etat) {
                          indices.push_back(i);
                        }
                } 
                  return indices;
                }','std::vector<int> diff_indices(const std::vector<int>& indices) {
                  std::vector<int> diffs(indices.size() - 1);
                  for (size_t i = 1; i < indices.size(); ++i) {
                  diffs[i - 1] = indices[i] - indices[i - 1];
                }
                  return diffs;
                }'))
  resultats<-msbc1(days,params,ptrans,simulate_weather_vectorized)
  
  Vn_S<-sd(resultats[["diff_indices_1"]])
  Vn_N<-sd(resultats[["diff_indices_2"]])
  Vn_P<-sd(resultats[["diff_indices_3"]])
  nbS<-resultats[["nbr de S"]]
  nbN<-resultats[["nbr de N"]]
  nbP<-resultats[["nbr de P"]]
  
  cppFunction('NumericVector msbc2(int n_simul,List params, double Vn_S,double Vn_N,int N,int s,int days,NumericVector pacc,int nbS,int nbN,int nbP, Function rremb){
              RNGScope scope;
              NumericVector R_values(n_simul);
              for (int sim=0;sim<n_simul;sim++){
                double epsilon_S = R::runif(-Vn_S, Vn_S);
                double epsilon_N = R::runif(-Vn_N, Vn_N);
                double epsilon_P = -(epsilon_S + epsilon_N);
                NumericVector repetitions(3);
                repetitions[0] = nbS + epsilon_S;
                repetitions[1] = nbN + epsilon_N;
                repetitions[2] = nbP + epsilon_P;
                std::vector<int> weather;
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < repetitions[i]; ++j) {
                      weather.push_back(i + 1); // Remplir avec 1, 2, ou 3 pour S, N, P
                    }
                }
                NumericMatrix prob_accident(N, days);
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                  for (int j = 0; j < days; j++) {
                    if (weather[j] == 1) {
                      prob_accident(i, j) = pacc[0];
                    } else if (weather[j] == 2) {
                      prob_accident(i, j) = pacc[1];
                    } else {
                      prob_accident(i, j) = pacc[2];
                    }
                  }   
                }
                NumericMatrix accidents(N, days);
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                  for (int j = 0; j < days; ++j) {
                    accidents(i, j) = R::rbinom(1, prob_accident(i, j));
                  }
                }
                int num_accidents=0;
                for(std::vector<int>::size_type i = 0; i < accidents.size(); i++) {
                  num_accidents += accidents[i];  // Ajouter chaque valeur à num_accidents
                }
                NumericVector rremb_values_r = rremb(num_accidents, params);
                std::vector<double> rremb_values = Rcpp::as<std::vector<double>>(rremb_values_r);
                int sum_rremb=0;
                for (std::vector<int>::size_type i = 0;i<rremb_values.size();i++){
                  sum_rremb+=rremb_values[i];
                }
                R_values[sim]=sum_rremb-s;
              }
            return R_values;
  }
              ')
  R_values<-msbc2(n.simul,params,Vn_S,Vn_N,N,s,days,pacc,nbS,nbN,nbP,rremb)
  # Calcul de l'espérance conditionnelle m(s) = E(R - s | R > s)
  ms1 <- R_values[R_values > 0]
  m_s<- mean(ms1)
  
  sigma<-sd(ms1)
  n<-length(ms1)
  
  return(list(ms = m_s, demi.largeur=(1.96*sigma/sqrt(n))))
}
params <- list(
  alpha=1,
  x0=1,
  eta=3.5,
  s=4000,
  N=10000,
  ptrans=c(0.3,0.2,0.1, 0.4),
  pacc = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.1)  # Probabilité d'accident en Soleil, Nuages, Pluie
)
system.time(c<-msb.c(1000,params))
c
